principle: Decomposition before comparison; provenance before relationship claims; automation output is workflow state, not evidence.
known_limits: Causal relationship inference still requires phylogenetic, spatial, contact, source-dependence and missingness-aware models.
DRH semantic crosswalk coverage remains early and must expand through reviewed thematic batches.
Global search is ontology-expanded lexical retrieval; calibrated hybrid vector retrieval is not yet active.
Runtime database activation remains unverified; deterministic public federation projections remain the public operational source of truth.
Reference deity/spirit coverage is still far below global target scale.
No discovered media candidate renders publicly before separate identity and rights approval.
